resources.string: A reminder for water, a walk, or a task you choose.
Could not refresh reminders. Any list below may be out of date. Please refresh before adding another reminder.
Without alarm access, reminders may be delayed. Enable it before adding a reminder.
Could not open settings. Open your phone settings, choose Aasra under Alarms & reminders, then return and refresh.
What should we remind you about?
Write the reminder in your own words.
Use the phone time zone shown above. Enter a 24-hour time: 9 and 00 for morning, 21 and 00 for evening.
The selected date is the first reminder. Daily repeats are managed by your phone. Check times after travelling or a clock change.
Upcoming reminders and pending daily reminders. This list does not confirm delivery or record whether a task was completed.
No active reminders. Add one when you need it.
The stored time has passed. The next daily time has not been recorded yet. Refresh to check again.
This removes the reminder and cancels its alarm.
This removes the reminder and stops all future daily repeats.
Enter what you want to be reminded about.
Choose a future date and time, including for the first daily reminder.
This time is skipped or occurs twice because the clocks change. Choose another time.
The phone time zone changed. Check the time zone above and review your date and time before saving.
Reminder saved. Delivery and timing depend on phone settings, including notification permission.
Could not confirm that the reminder was saved and scheduled. An entry may remain below. If it does, cancel it before trying again.
Reminder saved, but the list could not refresh. Do not save it again. Refresh to check the list.
This reminder already has an entry at that time. No new reminder was added. If an earlier save failed, cancel that entry before trying again.
Could not confirm cancellation. Refresh and check the list before trying again.
Reminder cancelled, but the list could not refresh. Refresh to see the updated list.
